map.铆接强度计算 使用指南: Riveted Joint Strength Calculation User Guide
map.输入铆钉直径、板厚、铆钉数、板宽及载荷，校核剪切、挤压、撕裂强度并计算铆缝效率: Enter the rivet diameter, plate thickness, number of rivets, plate width, and load to check shear, bearing, and tear strength and compute the riveted joint efficiency
map.剪切 τ=F/As、挤压 σc=F/Ab、撕裂 σt=F/A_net 校核。: Check shear τ = F/As, bearing σc = F/Ab, and tear σt = F/A_net.
map.判破坏模式（剪切/挤压/撕裂控制）。: Determine the failure mode (shear / bearing / tear control).
map.：F=8 kN、销径 d=10、板厚 t=8、n=1 个：As=π·d²/4·n: : F = 8 kN, pin diameter d = 10, plate thickness t = 8, n = 1: As = π·d²/4·n = 78.54 mm²; τ = 8000/78.54 = 101.9 MPa; Ab = d·t·n = 80 mm²; σc = 8000/80 = 100 MPa. If [τ] = 120 and [σc] = 150, shear governs but the joint is adequate.
map.：n=2：As=157.1、τ=50.9 MPa，强度翻倍。: : with n = 2: As = 157.1 and τ = 50.9 MPa — twice the capacity.
map.单剪一个剪切面、双剪两个，双剪承剪面积翻倍、承载力更高，用于厚板连接。: A single shear has one shear plane while double shear has two, doubling the shear area and raising capacity — used for thick-plate connections.
map.板在孔边被拉裂（净截面），A_net=(板宽−d)·t，边距不足时撕裂控制。: The plate tears at the hole edge (net section), with A_net = (plate width − d)·t; insufficient edge distance means tearing governs.
